evidence: bare_number_card: In seg1:mid and seg1:end every bar track is empty. Only the right-hand values (-8, -6.5, -5, -3.5, -2.3) carry the data, so it is a column of numbers, not a demonstration.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: seg1:start through seg1:end show a horizontal bar chart of permafrost temperature (1983-2023). Every bar track is empty, with only a tiny nub at the left. The values sit in a column on the right, and Data wanders between rows with no task.
weakest_scene.root_cause: Bars for negative temperatures were drawn with zero or negative length, so the chart renders as empty tracks. The scene also repeats the same five numbers seg0 already showed, as a plainer chart.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Replace it with a scene made of the subject: a cross-section of frozen ground whose ice line or frost-blue fill recedes as a thermometer embedded in the soil climbs from -8 to -2.3. Data should do the warming, for example by pushing the needle or chipping at ice that shrinks, and the payoff number should land early in the beat.
